output.summary: KEP-4080 proposes factoring kube-apiserver and kube-controller-manager onto one or more new staging repositories (suggested k/generic-controlplane) that consume k/apiserver and carry a reusable subset of their generic functionality, excluding workload-specific resources. The KEP is in provisional status at stage alpha.
output.rationale: Kubernetes control planes bundle generic resources and controllers with container orchestration, which makes the generic parts hard to reuse. The proposal factors the generic parts into a library-style staging repo with a sample binary, moving code progressively without user-visible changes. Reviewers agreed the exact repo split would be decided during implementation, and the repo creation was deferred until the package structure is clear.
output.outcome_reason: Status is provisional, so the KEP has not been finalized or implemented. The sources do not explain the alpha stage choice beyond the reviewer note that the typical alpha/beta/GA process does not fully apply because the moved code is already GA.

alternatives.option: Split into separate generic-apiserver and generic-controller-manager repos
alternatives.why_not: Raised by jpbetz as a possible split; sttts agreed it could be done and said it is to be discussed, so it was not settled in the sources.

alternatives.option: Include a combined one-binary goal for apiserver and controller-manager
alternatives.why_not: deads2k argued separate binaries have aged well and combining looks like a mistake; sttts disagreed, saying the goal does not force a topology and it belongs in the KEP. The disagreement was not resolved in the sources.
sttts said the repos should wait until the code moves are done and the final package structure is clear.

evidence.quote: The factoring will be progressive: we will start with new repo(s) adding nothing to `k/apiserver`, refactor in-place and then progressively move generic functionality
yes, we wait. I put a sentence that we will decide when the final package structure through in-place moves is clear.
I think I'm OK with figuring out the exact split as we go, but I don't want sign off on just a single staging repo in the KEP
This appears to capture our goal of splitting out a "batteries included" generic apiserver.
